title: EnterpriseEmployeeModel
description: Enterprise-grade database schema definition for Global Employee profiles in a Multi-tenant HRMS, designed for compliance, performance, payroll, equity, and verification tracking.

employee_id.description: Unique global employee identifier formatted by region and serial number (e.g., EMP-APAC-100293).

tenant_id.description: Unique multi-tenant isolation identifier for enterprise clients.

employee_status.description: Current employment status of the employee.

tax_compliance.description: Database object tracking global tax compliance, local declarations, withholdings, and audit status.

local_municipality.description: City or municipal tax district identifier.

ciphertext.description: Base64 encoded encrypted tax ID (e.g., SSN, PAN, National ID).

iv.description: Initialization vector used for symmetric encryption.

key_version.description: Version of the KMS key used for encryption.

exempt_status.description: Flags if employee is completely exempt from statutory income withholdings.

tax_filing_history.description: Historical records of annual tax filings and corporate declarations generated.

digital_signature_hash.description: SHA-256 validation fingerprint of the submitted document.

tax_bracket_details.description: Defines applicable tax brackets and rates by jurisdiction and tax type.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which these brackets apply.

marginal_rate_percent.description: Marginal tax rate for income within this bracket.

base_tax_amount.description: Fixed tax amount for income up to the previous bracket's max.

tax_treaty_benefits.description: Details any tax treaty benefits claimed by the employee.

treaty_country_iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the treaty country.

treaty_article_reference.description: Specific article of the tax treaty (e.g., 'Article 15 - Dependent Personal Services').

benefit_type.description: Type of benefit claimed under the treaty.

effective_start_date.description: Date from which the treaty benefit is effective.

effective_end_date.description: Date until which the treaty benefit is effective, if applicable.

reciprocity_agreements.description: Agreements governing tax treatment for income earned across different jurisdictions (e.g., state-to-state).

source_jurisdiction_code.description: Code for the jurisdiction where income is earned (e.g., 'PA' for Pennsylvania, 'US-NY' for New York State).

target_jurisdiction_code.description: Code for the employee's resident jurisdiction (e.g., 'NJ' for New Jersey, 'US-CA' for California State).

agreement_type.description: Type of tax covered by the reciprocity agreement.

effective_date.description: Date when the reciprocity agreement became effective for this employee.

notes.description: Any specific notes or conditions related to this agreement.

compliance_audit_logs.description: Immutable log of compliance-related actions and reviews for the employee's tax profile.

log_id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

actor_user_id.description: ID of the user or system responsible for the event.

description.description: Detailed description of the compliance event.

related_document_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of any related document, if applicable.

tiered_payroll_structure.description: Compensation model outlining grade brackets, base pays, performance-tied commissions, variable bonuses, and priority-sorted deductions.

tier_limit.description: Revenue target threshold for this tier.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the allowance.

provider_name.description: Name of the provider, if applicable.

up_to_employee_contribution_percent.description: The upper bound of employee's contribution for this tier (e.g. up to 3%).

employer_match_ratio.description: The matching factor (e.g., 1.0 means 100% match, 0.5 means 50% match).

deductions_hierarchy.description: Determines the priority order for payroll processing of deductions, specifically for scenarios with insufficient earnings.

anniversary_bonuses.description: Details tracking work anniversary bonuses with milestone years and corresponding bonus amounts.

milestone_year.description: The specific work anniversary year (e.g., 5, 10, 15 years of service).

amount.description: The monetary amount of the anniversary bonus.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the bonus amount (e.g., USD, EUR).

payout_date.description: The date when the bonus for this milestone was or will be paid.

status.description: Current status of the bonus payout for this milestone.

esop_vesting_schedule.description: Details regarding equity grants, vesting types, schedules, exercise history, and compliance with option pools.

vesting_milestone_ref.description: Maps to a specific performance trigger if performance-based.

fmv_at_exercise.description: Fair Market Value per share on the date of exercise.

equity_account_reference.description: Brokerage account ID linked to equity disbursement.

current_fmv_per_share.description: Fair Market Value per share as of the last valuation date.

vesting_calculation_method.description: Method used to calculate shares vested per period after cliff (e.g., 25% after year 1, then 1/48th monthly).

acceleration_clauses.description: Conditions under which vesting might accelerate.

trigger_event.description: Description of the event that triggers acceleration.

acceleration_percentage.description: Percentage of remaining unvested shares that accelerate (0-100).

effective_date_mechanism.description: How the effective date of acceleration is determined (e.g., 'Date of Event', '30_Days_Post_Event').

forfeiture_history.description: Records of forfeited shares due to specific events.

summary_metrics.description: Calculated summary metrics for the equity grant.

total_shares_vested.description: Total number of shares that have vested to date.

total_shares_exercisable.description: Total number of vested shares that have not yet been exercised.

total_shares_unvested.description: Total number of shares remaining to vest.

total_shares_forfeited.description: Total number of shares that have been forfeited.

vesting_completion_percentage.description: Percentage of total granted shares that have vested.

projected_unrealized_gain_loss.description: Estimated unrealized gain/loss based on current FMV for exercisable shares.

last_vesting_event_date.description: Date of the most recent vesting event.

next_vesting_event_date.description: Date of the next scheduled vesting event.

next_vesting_shares.description: Number of shares scheduled to vest at the next event.

expiration_tracking.description: Details regarding the expiration of equity options.

option_expiration_date.description: The final date by which vested options must be exercised.

days_to_expiration.description: Number of days remaining until the options expire (calculated from current date).

post_termination_exercise_window_days.description: Number of days an employee has to exercise vested options after termination (if applicable).

performance_matrix.description: Employee performance evaluations including multi-source appraisals, goal cycles (OKRs), calibrated matrices (9-box grid), and improvement program tracking.

overall_nine_box_score.description: An aggregated numeric score (1-9) representing the employee's placement within the 9-box grid, useful for quantitative analysis.

individual_performance_reviews.description: Records of individual performance reviews conducted for the employee.

review_id.description: Unique identifier for this performance review (e.g., REV-APAC-123456).

review_period_identifier.description: Identifier for the review period (e.g., '2023 Annual Review', 'Q3 2024 Mid-Year').

employee_rating.description: Overall performance rating on a scale of 1 to 5, where 5 is exceptional.

review_status.description: Current status of the performance review.

manager_feedback.description: Mandatory detailed feedback provided by the manager.

reviewer_employee_id.description: The employee ID of the manager who conducted this review.

allOf.description: A manager cannot self-review; 'reviewer_employee_id' must not be the same as the 'employee_id' of the employee whose profile this is.

background_verification.description: Multi-agency verification status across education, criminal record, employment, and credit scoring.

report_reference_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the background check report.

benefits_enrollment.description: Enterprise benefit allocations, including health insurance tiers, supplementary options, tax-advantaged contributions, and dependent coverage.

gym_membership.description: Details about the employee's gym membership.

enrolled.description: Indicates if the employee is enrolled in a company-sponsored gym membership.

monthly_fee.description: The monthly fee or reimbursement amount for the gym membership.

provider_name.description: Name of the gym or wellness provider.

membership_id.description: Optional unique ID for the specific gym membership.

last_verification_date.description: Date of the last verification of membership status.

parking_permit_allocation.description: Details regarding employee parking permit allocation.

permit_number.description: Unique identifier for the employee's parking permit.

assigned_parking_zone.description: The specific parking zone or area assigned to the employee.

desk_allocation.description: Details regarding employee desk allocation within the office.

desk_id.description: Unique identifier for the allocated desk (e.g., DESK-BLDG1-FLR3-D045).

building_name.description: Name or identifier of the building where the desk is located.

floor_number.description: Floor number where the desk is situated.

zone_identifier.description: Specific zone or area within the floor (e.g., 'West Wing', 'Open Space A').

is_assigned.description: Indicates if the desk is currently assigned to this employee.

assignment_start_date.description: Date when the desk assignment started.

assignment_end_date.description: Date when the desk assignment is scheduled to end (null if permanent or indefinite).

laptop_allocation.description: Details regarding the employee's allocated company laptop, conforming to strict HRMS allocation requirements.

allocation_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific laptop allocation event.

asset_tag.description: Unique physical asset tag assigned to the laptop.

model_name.description: Manufacturer and model name of the laptop.

issue_date.description: Date when the laptop was issued to the employee.

assigner_employee_id.description: The employee ID of the IT or HR personnel who assigned the laptop. This ID should not be the same as the 'employee_id' of the recipient (the employee whose profile this is part of), preventing self-allocation of the asset management process.

return_date.description: Date when the laptop was returned, if applicable.

status.description: Current status of the laptop asset.

time_and_attendance.description: Configurable parameters tracking leave accrual policies, balances, work schedules, clock logs, and exception overrides.

work_authorization_visa.description: Monitors right-to-work status, passports, visa sponsorships, legal process lifecycle, and filing milestones.

sponsor_legal_entity.description: Name of the corporate subsidiary sponsoring the visa.

career_and_learning_development.description: Learning path assignments, professional certifications, corporate-sponsored course tracking, and training budget allocation.

disciplinary_and_grievance_records.description: Maintains restricted-access records of disciplinary incidents, HR investigations, grievances filed, mediation sessions, and appeal logs.

allegations_details_encrypted.description: Highly encrypted description of the policy violation.
